summary: Procure privileged admin seats and configure SCIM/SSO for TraceGuard security vendor onboarding
description:
Issue summary: Security team is onboarding TraceGuard (third-party vendor providing runtime threat detection). We need to purchase 8 privileged admin seats (6 permanent + 2 ephemeral) and complete SSO (SAML) + SCIM provisioning.
Impact: Delay prevents TraceGuard from being configured against prod agent fleets, delaying security telemetry ingest and scheduled scans. Risk to compliance if onboarding is not completed before the 2026-03-22 audit window.
Business justification: TraceGuard will provide runtime anomaly detection for dedicated GPU clusters used by enterprise customers. Seats are required for Security Engineers and two service accounts for automation.
Requirements:
- Procure 8 admin seats on TraceGuard Enterprise plan (line items/sku provided by vendor).
- Configure SAML SSO via Okta (vendor supports SP-initiated SAML).
- Enable SCIM provisioning for email->role mapping (admin role for 6 users, service-account role for 2).
- IP allowlist entry for vendor connector (10.140.22.0/24).
- KMS access: vendor requires encrypted token storage; agree to restricted KMS key usage via existing Redwood KMS policy.
- Provide vendor with POC contact and invoice COA codes (Cost Center: ENG-Sec, GL: 5402).
Approvals needed: Security lead (Anika Rao), Finance charge owner (Ravi Singh), Legal review for DPA & standard security questionnaire (currently in Legal queue).
Vendor contact: Linh Tran (linh.tran@traceguard.io). Vendor quote attached in Confluence page.
Desired timeline: Purchase order and SSO test account created by 2026-03-17.
PO/Invoice notes: Please route invoices to AP with reference PO# TBD. Chargeback tag: eng-security.
Special constraints: We must request a temporary 6-month license for the ephemeral seats, with an option to convert to perpetual admin seats at renewal. Also require audit log access for compliance (vendor must retain logs for 90 days).
